snippet.title: Warframe | The Shadowgrapher Official Gameplay Trailer - Available Now On All Platforms!
snippet.description:
Return to the Vesper Relay in Warframe's latest update, The Shadowgrapher! Though long-destroyed, a strange painting that hangs in its ruins has beckoned to the Arbiters of Hexis, prompting you to investigate. Visit the Relay and enter the canvas of chaos that lies within to illuminate a mystery long lost to the shadows…

You'll also meet the 64th Warframe, Follie, an inkblot-based artistic maestro who bends reality and controls enemy crowds with her myriad sketches and tricks. Joining her are the latest incarnations of the Origin System's favorite odd couple: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis. With full suites of mecha-inspired Customizations, the rapid meets the ravenous like you've never seen before.

Our first standalone update of 2026 also expands and improves your overall Warframe experience with the addition of the new Follie's Hunt game mode and numerous quality-of-life improvements including (but not limited to): legacy Quest updates, fresh faces for your Operator and Drifter, new Adversary Weapons for you to earn and TennoGen Shadowgrapher.

For more details, visit https://warframe.com/the-shadowgrapher

►► WHAT IS WARFRAME? 

Join 85M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe. For more info, visit https://warframe.com.
